manifest.name: ud-downs-q6k-imat-lmhead-q8
manifest.description: unsloth UD-Q4_K_M (V0) with every routed expert down projection on Q6_K, rounded by the contributed kq_imat encoder, and the output head on Q8_0; all other units keep V0's exact bytes. kq_imat chooses each Q6_K super-block's scales with llama.cpp's importance-weighted search (make_qx_quants) on the pinned per-expert statistics (exps_down.sumsq / count), then refines the stored scale codes and the f16 super-scale by weighted least squares. On the pinned BF16 weights of layers 20 and 38 it lowers the importance-weighted error of the Q6_K downs by 26-32% against kq_rtn (and 11% below unsloth's own Q6_K bytes for layer 38), at the same size and speed as the kq_rtn recipe (about 27 GiB).
